status: Schema resolution before outcome comparison; first two gene rows seen only to check parsing
measurement: Project Score combined Sanger v2/Broad 21Q2 corrected fold_change_values; negative indicates depletion. Use negative median fold change for the primary endpoint. No Bayes-factor sign assumptions.
headers: Five metadata rows: names, model IDs, source, QC, gene-field labels; three gene identifier columns
screen_selection: QC TRUE only; prefer Sanger over Broad when duplicate model IDs; first column if same-source duplicate; median within known patient_id. Exclude missing patient IDs.
cohort: Pancreas tissue with exact adenocarcinoma details; other pancreas histologies excluded. Other-lineage comparator excludes all pancreas and missing tissue; no donor overlap.
training_overlap: Exclude PANC1 and HPNE names/synonyms and all known matching patient IDs
gene_matching: Unique unversioned Ensembl IDs directly in matrix, matched to frozen predictions. Supplemental common-essential/core-fitness flags must be available for primary eligibility.
coverage: Primary requires 80 percent pancreatic donor coverage; selectivity additionally requires 80 percent comparator coverage.
top_k: Include all ties at the kth score among primary-eligible genes; report actual count. Null samples use that actual count without replacement. Secondary p-values exploratory, unadjusted.
inference: Gene permutation assumes exchangeable genes and does not control gene length, expression or network confounding. Donor bootstrap measures cell-model stability, not patient confidence. No clinically validated performance claim.
